records.query: Apple 最近有什麼跟 Siri 有關的法律訴訟或和解消息？
records.answer:
Apple 正在就「增強 Siri 功能」未實際存在而被指誤導消費者的訴訟，提出一項最高可達 **$95**、總額 **2.5 億美元（$250 million）** 的和解方案【AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。

- 這是一件在加州北區聯邦法院提起的集體訴訟，原告指稱 Apple 以尚未推出的「Enhanced Siri features」作為賣點，誘使消費者購買 iPhone 15 Pro、iPhone 15 Pro Max 以及 iPhone 16【AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- 和解金額上限為 **2.5 億美元（$250 million）**，每部符合條件的 iPhone 初始賠償 **$25**，最終金額不超過 **$95**【AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- 受惠的約 **0.37 億（37 million）** 位 iPhone 用戶，購機期間為 **2024‑06‑10** 至 **2025‑03‑29**【AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- Apple 表示已達成此和解，以便專注於「提供最創新的產品與服務」【AAPL_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  

因此，Apple 最近的 Siri 相關法律動態是此筆涉及數億美元的和解協議。

records.query: Apple 在最近的 WWDC 上關於 Siri 有什麼新消息？
records.answer:
Apple 在本次 WWDC 上宣布全新 AI 驅動的 Siri（稱為 **Siri AI**），將於今年稍後以 beta 形式推出，具備從使用者應用程式中提取上下文、跨 App 檢索資訊（例如直接回覆「我妹妹在訊息裡推薦的播客名稱」）的能力，並以 Google 的 Gemini 系列模型（包括 Gemini Flash‑Lite、Flash、Pro 以及 Image 模型）為核心技術，同時不使用 Google 向客戶提供的模型或基礎建設【AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0】。  

- Siri AI 旨在強化語音輸入與即時問答功能，讓助理更像「數位幫手」而非僅是提醒器【AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0】；同時 Apple 也在 WWDC 中說明，Siri AI 會整合至 Safari、Password 與 Messages 等應用，成為 Apple Intelligence 生態的一環【AAPL_News_20260612_03.txt, chunk #0】。  
- 這項重新設計的 Siri 功能已開發兩年，透過 AI 整合可安全地利用個人化上下文，提升資訊檢索與第三方 App 自動化，並以「Search」或「Ask Prompt」等 Google‑驅動的功能與 ChatGPT、Grok、Gemini 等競爭對手抗衡【AAPL_News_20260612_03.txt, chunk #0】。  
- Apple 高層在發表會後的問答環節中再次強調，Siri AI 使用的是 Google 的模型，但 **不** 直接採用 Google 向其客戶部署的模型或基礎設施【AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0】。  

總結來說，Apple 在 WWDC 上的 Siri 新消息包括：推出以 Google Gemini 為基礎的 Siri AI beta、支援跨 App 上下文感知與語音問答、整合至多項核心應用以提升使用者體驗，並以此在 AI 助理市場與主要競爭者正面交鋒。

After two years of delays, Apple's (
AAPL
) reinvented Siri, Siri AI,
appears ready for primetime
. The company unveiled the AI-powered version of its assistant at its Worldwide Developers Conference in Cupertino, Calif., on Monday, saying it will launch, albeit as a beta, later this year. The update is designed to transform Siri from a glorified kitchen timer to a
digital helper for the AI age
. Apple said Siri AI will be able to pull context from your apps, allowing you to, say, ask it the name of a podcast your sister recommended via text and have it presented to you without opening any separate apps or services. The idea is for Siri AI to recognize what you want, when you want it, and surface it, whether it's content on your device or from the web. It's more or less what Apple promised when it showed off its AI-enhanced Siri and Apple Intelligence at WWDC 2024. And in early demos, Siri AI, which rides on Apple Intelligence, appears to deliver on Apple's initial vision for its reimagined Siri. And it's thanks, at least in part, to Google (
GOOG
,
GOOGL
). Siri gets Google brains
In January, Apple and Google signed an agreement for Apple to use the search giant's Gemini models to power its improved Siri. That gave Apple the high-powered AI models it needed to move Siri AI forward, after its own models fell short,
Bloomberg's Mark Gurman previously reported
. During a question and answer session following Apple's WWDC keynote, senior vice president of software engineering Craig Federighi explained how Apple uses Google's models to give Siri AI its smarts. The software chief was sure to point out that Siri AI isn't just a rebranded version of Google's own Gemini assistant. Federighi explained how the Gemini assistant uses Google's Gemini models, including Gemini Flash-Lite, Gemini Flash, Gemini Pro, and its Gemini Image models. When it comes to grounding those models in world knowledge, he said, Gemini takes advantage of Google Search. Apple, Federighi said, uses none of those things. "We use none of the models that Google deploys to their customers, nor do we use the infrastructure and means by which they employ models to their customers," he explained.

NVIDIA 最近與 IREN 簽署了多項大型合作協議，包括 5 年期 34 億美元的 AI Cloud 合約、價值 21 億美元的投資權利，以及共同部署多達 5 GW 的 NVIDIA HGX‑aligned AI 基礎設施【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1】。  

- IREN 宣布與 NVIDIA 簽訂 5 年、34 億美元的 AI Cloud 合約，將在 60 MW 的空冷 Blackwell GPU 容量（主要在 Childress）部署 NVIDIA GPU，並於 2027 年初開始加速擴張【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1】。  
- 同時，NVIDIA 提供 21 億美元的投資權利，該投資僅在 NVIDIA GPU 基礎設施部署後逐步解鎖，全部投資金額在部署 600,000 顆 GPU 後才會完全生效【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1】。  
- IREN 亦獲得 NVIDIA 5 年內購買最高 3,000 萬普通股（每股 70 美元）的認購權，若全部行使，最高可帶來 21 億美元的潛在資金【NVDA_News_20260508_02.txt, chunk #0】。  
- 合作計畫包括在 2026 年建置 480 MW AI Cloud 容量、部署約 150,000 顆 GPU，並目標在 2026 年底達成 37 億美元的 ARR；2027 年則計畫擴增至 1,210 MW 的總容量【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- 此外，NVIDIA 仍將持續支援 IREN 在全球（包括美國、歐洲與亞太）擴展 AI 計算基礎設施，利用 IREN 已確保的 5 GW 電力資源來部署 NVIDIA HGX‑aligned AI 基礎設施【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1】。

China market for Nvidia AI chips to open 'over time': Huang
AFP
Tue, May 19, 2026 at 11:02 AM GMT+8
2 min read
NVDA
-1.33%
Nvidia boss Jensen Huang expects China to eventually open its market to high-end US chips that can train and run artificial intelligence systems. But he did not discuss sales of the powerful H200 model with top officials in Beijing, the businessman told Bloomberg Television in an interview broadcast Monday. Huang travelled to the country last week with US President Donald Trump, who met Chinese President Xi Jinping. The superpowers are in a fierce race for AI supremacy, and the H200 chip had until recently been barred from sale in China by Washington over national security concerns. However, there is no sign that Chinese tech companies are buying them, as Beijing ramps up domestic chip development in a bid to challenge US dominance in the key sector. "H200s are licensed to sell to China.

[NVDA] But the Chinese government has to decide how much of their local market do they want to protect," Huang said. "My sense is that over time the market will open," added Huang, CEO of Nvidia -- the world's most valuable company, due to huge demand for its AI hardware. Trump said in December he had reached an agreement with Xi to ease the restrictions on H200 chips, a move some US lawmakers have warned could help the Chinese military. Nvidia's most top-of-the-range offerings, the Blackwell and forthcoming Rubin series, remain banned for sale in China. Xi told a delegation of US business executives on Thursday that China would "open wider" to the world.

records.query: 新聞報導 Apple 為什麼被視為值得長期持有的股票？
records.answer:
Apple 被視為值得長期持有的股票，主要是因為它擁有龐大的裝置生態系、持續成長的高毛利服務、極佳的現金產生能力，以及穩健的資本回饋政策【AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #1】。  

- **生態系與黏著度**：Apple 具備 25 億以上的裝置安裝基礎，生態系統鎖定效應讓使用者難以離開，形成持續的收入來源【AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #1】。  
- **服務收入與定價能力**：服務部門已展現雙位數成長，且公司能在服務上提升價格，顯示在生態系內具備明顯的定價權力【AAPL_News_20260612_04.txt, chunk #1】。  
- **現金流與財務彈性**：Apple 在過去 12 個月產生 1,402 億美元（$140.2 billion） 的營運現金，且自由現金流達 1,292 億美元（$129.2 billion），足以支撐每年 77 億美元（$7.7 billion） 的股息與 370 億美元（$37.0 billion） 的回購計畫【AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5】。  
- **資本回饋**：公司已宣布再度執行 1,000 億美元（$100 billion） 的股票回購，並提升股息，為投資人提供明確的回報底線【AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5】。  
- **iPhone 與 AI 推動**：iPhone 銷量在最近四季上升 16%，iPhone 17 週期更帶來約 23% 的增長，且 AI 功能（如 Siri 重新設計）預計提升使用者黏著度與服務變現能力【AAPL_News_20260612_03.txt, chunk #0】【AAPL_News_20260612_04.txt, chunk #2】。  
- **盈利與估值**：雖然前瞻本益比約 33.5 倍屬於溢價，但考慮到其高毛利（47.9%）與穩定的營運現金流，投資人仍將其視為核心長期持有標的【AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #5】。  

綜合以上因素——強大的生態系、服務收入的高毛利與持續成長、充沛的現金流與積極的資本回饋，以及 iPhone 與 AI 帶來的需求動能——使 Apple 被廣泛認為是「核心」且「值得長期持有」的股票。

records.query: NVIDIA 最新財報顯示的營收成長速度如何？加上新聞中它與 IREN 最新的 AI 雲端合作案，這反映出公司在資料中心布局上的哪些具體進展？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 在最新的2026財季（截至2026年4月26日的第一季）營收較去年同期增長約 **85.2%**，從 **440.62 億美元（$44,062 百萬）** 提升至 **816.15 億美元（$81,615 百萬）**【NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #0】；這與公司基本面文件中列示的 **營收成長 YoY 0.852**（即 85.2%）相符【NVDA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #0】。

**與 IREN 的 AI 雲端合作具體顯示的資料中心布局進展**：

1. **長期 AI Cloud 合約**  
   - IREN 簽署了 **5 年、價值 34 億美元（$3.4 billion） 的 AI Cloud 合約**，以部署 NVIDIA 的 Blackwell GPU（空冷）於 60 MW 的 Childress 設施【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
   - 合約下已產生約 **7 億美元（$700 million） 的 ARR**，與 NVIDIA 合約相關【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。

2. **GPU 部署規模**  
   - 合約預計在 2026 年完成 **150,000 顆 GPU** 的部署，並在 2027 年擴增至 **730,000 顆 GPU**（含 600,000 顆 GPU 觸發 NVIDIA 21 億美元（$2.1 billion） 投資的條件）【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1】【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #4】。  
   - NVIDIA 的投資 **21 億美元（$2.1 billion）** 只有在 GPU 基礎設施部署至 **600,000 顆 GPU** 後才完全生效【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #4】。

3. **電力與容量建設**  
   - IREN 已將 **secured power 提升至 5 GW**，其中 2026 年目標建置 **480 MW** AI Cloud 容量（含 150,000 顆 GPU），2027 年則擴至 **1,210 MW**【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
   - 具體建設包括 **300 MW 的液冷 Childress 項目**、**50 MW 空冷 GPU** 在 Prince George、**80 MW** 在 Mackenzie，以及 **50 MW** 在 Childress 的改造【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。

4. **地理佈局擴張**  
   - 透過收購 **Nostrum Group**，IREN 在西班牙獲得 **490 MW** 的電力資源，為歐洲 AI 資料中心提供基礎設施【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #3】。  
   - 同時在澳洲持續開發項目，視為 APAC 的「前沿」市場，以因應區域需求限制【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #3】。

5. **資金與融資安排**  
   - IREN 表示 **95% 的 Microsoft GPU 相關資本支出** 透過預付款與 GPU 融資以約 **3% 的平均利率** 完成，顯示 NVIDIA 生態系統內的資金流動與合作模式【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #3】。

綜合以上，NVIDIA 不僅在最新財季展現出近 85% 的營收高速成長，亦透過與 IREN 的大型 AI Cloud 合約與 GPU 部署計畫，實質推進了全球資料中心的電力供應、GPU 數量、液冷與空冷基礎建設，以及歐洲與亞太地區的佈局，鞏固其在 AI 資料中心市場的領導地位。

May 18 (Reuters) - Anthropic said on Monday it is revising its earlier position to allow users of its Mythos cybersecurity model ‌to share information about cyber threats with others who may be exposed ‌to similar vulnerabilities. Mythos, announced on April 7, is being deployed as part of Anthropic's "Project Glasswing," a controlled ​initiative under which select organizations, including major tech firms such as Amazon,
Microsoft
,
Nvidia
and
Apple
, are permitted to use the unreleased Claude Mythos Preview model for defensive cybersecurity purposes. Mythos' capabilities to code at a high level have given it a potentially ‌unprecedented ability to identify cybersecurity ⁠vulnerabilities and devise ways to exploit them, according to experts. Last week, Anthropic began telling partners that they are generally permitted to disclose ⁠their involvement in Glasswing and, at their own discretion, share findings, best practices, tools or code developed through the program. "We fully support our partners sharing findings with each ​other and ​companies outside of Glasswing to triage vulnerabilities," ​an Anthropic spokesperson said in a ‌statement. "While there was never a specific Glasswing NDA, confidentiality protections were something partners asked for at the outset and were built into agreements partners signed."
The protections were included in agreements with participating companies under which the model is provided, after partners sought assurances before sharing sensitive findings and expressed concern about being targeted by ‌attackers. "As the program has matured, we've adapted them ​to ensure key information can be shared broadly - ​including outside the program - for maximum ​defensive impact," the spokesperson added.

[MSFT] Anthropic said partners may share that ‌information with security teams at other companies, ​industry bodies, regulators and ​government agencies, open-source maintainers, the media or the public, subject to responsible-disclosure norms. The Pentagon is deploying Mythos to find and patch software vulnerabilities across ​the U.S. government even as ‌it races to complete a transition away from the AI company, the ​Defense Department's top technology official said last week. records.answer:
Tesla 汽車業務的毛利率在最近一季出現小幅下滑，但在半年期則顯著回升，呈現先降後升的混合走勢。  

- 2026 年 3 個月（截至 6 月 30 日）汽車總毛利率從 2025 年同季的 **17.2%** 降至 **16.9%**【TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #77】。  
- 同期間（6 個月）汽車總毛利率則從 2025 年的 **16.8%** 上升至 **18.7%**【TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #77】。  
- 若將汽車、服務與其他合併的部門看作整體，3 個月毛利率也從 **15.4%** 提升至 **16.4%**【TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #77】。

綜合來看，儘管 Tesla 的汽車毛利率在半年期已回升，但近期整體科技股的拋售情緒可能抑制其股價表現，使其短期內難以從毛利率改善中獲得即時的股價提振。投資者需同時關注成本與毛利率的持續走勢，以及宏觀市場對 Magnificent Seven 的情緒變化。

Shares in the "Magnificent Seven" -- ​a group that includes some of the biggest tech names on Wall Street, namely
Nvidia
,
Apple
, Amazon.com, Alphabet, Meta,
Tesla
, and Microsoft, have all declined since last Friday. The Roundhill Magnificent Seven ETF, which tracks these ‌stocks closely, declined over 2.4% ⁠since June 5, with some analysts saying investors were clearing their decks in order to prepare for the ⁠debut of Elon Musk's Space X on Friday. SpaceX posted a net loss of $4.94 billion in 2025, but its landmark listing targets a valuation of $1.77 ​trillion ​in a record-setting IPO, which would ​make it the seventh-biggest publicly ‌traded U.S. company by market value.

records.query: NVIDIA 的核心技術護城河是什麼？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 的核心護城河在於其完整的端到端加速運算平台，結合自家 GPU、CPU、DPU 硬體、深度整合的軟體堆疊（CUDA、AI Enterprise、NeMo 等）以及龐大的開發者與合作夥伴生態系，使競爭者難以在同時掌握硬體效能、軟體相容與生態規模上匹敵【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。

- **GPU 硬體領先**：NVIDIA 的 GPU 具備「數萬個運算核心」與專為深度學習設計的 Tensor Core，成為 AI 訓練與推論的核心運算單元【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。  
- **CUDA 軟體平台**：公司自 2006 年推出的 CUDA 開發平台讓所有 NVIDIA GPU 可被廣泛程式化，全球已有「超過 0.075 億（7.5 百萬）開發者」使用這些工具部署加速運算應用【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28】。  
- **完整 AI 軟體堆疊**：NVIDIA AI Enterprise 包含 NIM、NeMo、AI Blueprints 等模組，提供企業從模型開發、微調到安全部署的全流程支援，進一步鞏固平台黏著度【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28】。  
- **硬體與網路整合**：透過 2020 年收購 Mellanox，NVIDIA 將 GPU、CPU（Grace）與 DPU 整合成資料中心規模的計算與網路解決方案，形成「全棧」資料中心平台【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21】。  
- **Blackwell Ultra 平台**：在 FY2026，NVIDIA 推出 Blackwell Ultra 平台，將 36 顆 Grace CPU 與 72 顆 Blackwell GPU 以液冷方式結合，支援「實時千兆參數推論與訓練」，相較前代 Hopper 大幅提升 token 吞吐量並降低每 token 成本【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21】。  
- **生態系與合作夥伴**：NVIDIA 的技術可在「幾乎所有主要伺服器製造商與雲端服務提供商」上取得，同時透過 Inception 計畫、Deep Learning Institute 與數千所大學及上萬家新創合作，持續擴大開發者基礎與應用範圍【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28】。  
- **平台策略的獨特價值**：公司將硬體、系統、軟體、演算法、模型與資料集全部整合，形成「獨特的價值鏈」與「難以被快速複製」的競爭優勢【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。  

以上各點共同構成 NVIDIA 在加速運算與生成式 AI 市場的核心技術護城河。

- **可程式化的投資回報**：由於架構具備可程式化特性，NVIDIA 能在研發上進行槓桿式投資，讓多個數十億美元的市場共享相同技術基礎，進一步提升研發效率與市場滲透率。[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #27]  

總結來說，NVIDIA 以同一套以 GPU、CPU、CUDA 與高效能互連為核心的全堆疊平台，分別在 Compute & Networking 與 Graphics 兩大事業部門中，為資料中心、遊戲、專業視覺化與車用市場提供加速解決方案，實現跨領域的統一佈局與規模效益。[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #27][NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #24]

records.query: Microsoft 如何把 Copilot 整合進 Microsoft 365 的產品策略？
records.answer:
Microsoft 把 Copilot 直接嵌入 Microsoft 365 Commercial，讓它成為 AI‑驅動的生產力平台之一，與 Office、Windows、Enterprise Mobility + Security 等核心服務共同提供雲端訂閱收入【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52】。  

- **平台化整合**：Microsoft 365 Commercial 被描述為「AI‑powered business and productivity solutions platform」；此平台「bring together Office, Windows, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and Enterprise Mobility + Security」【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52】。  
- **收入構成**：在 Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端收入的組成項目中，列出「Microsoft 365 Copilot」與「Office、Windows、Enterprise Mobility + Security、Power BI、Exchange、SharePoint、Microsoft Teams、Microsoft 365 Security and Compliance」等服務【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52】。  
- **成長策略**：公司指出，Microsoft 365 Commercial 的成長「取決於我們在核心產品與服務上加入 AI‑enabled 工具、功能與 agentic 場景」，這包括在溝通、協作、分析、資安與合規等多個 AI 商務生產力領域加入 Copilot 功能【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52】。  
- **使用者與市場擴展**：透過將 Copilot 融入 Microsoft 365，Microsoft 期望在前線員工、中小企業以及新興市場中吸引更多付費使用者，同時提升每位使用者的平均收入（ARPU），因為 Copilot 為使用者提供 AI 助手式的工作流程自動化與洞察【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52】。  

總結來說，Microsoft 透過將 Copilot 作為 Microsoft 365 Commercial 產品組合的核心 AI 元件，與 Office、Windows 等既有服務緊密結合，並以此推動雲端訂閱收入與使用者基礎的雙重成長。

records.query: Microsoft 如何靠 Windows 帶動雲端與 Copilot 相關服務的參與度？
records.answer:
Microsoft 透過 Windows 這個作業系統，直接提升雲端業務與 Copilot 相關服務的使用率，因為 Windows 不只擴大了 PC 市場佔有率，還把使用者導向雲端與 AI 服務平台【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #49】。  

- **Windows 作為雲端入口**：Microsoft 明確指出「Leveraging Windows to fuel our cloud business」——也就是利用 Windows 的廣大安裝基礎，將使用者的工作負載、資料與應用程式引導至 Azure 與其他雲端服務，提升雲端資源的需求與消費【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #49】。  
- **提升 PC 市場佔有率**：透過持續改進 Windows 的功能與使用者體驗，Microsoft 期望「grow our share of the PC market」，這讓更多 PC 用戶自然接觸到 Microsoft 的雲端生態系統，進一步增加雲端服務的潛在客戶基礎【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #49】。  
- **驅動 Copilot 及其他服務的參與度**：在 Windows 生態系統中，Microsoft 直接「drive increased engagement with our services like … Copilot, Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365 Consumer」等，表示 Windows 平台會主動推介與整合 Copilot 等 AI 助手功能，讓使用者在日常工作與娛樂中更頻繁地使用這些 AI 服務【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #49】。  

綜合而言，Microsoft 以 Windows 為核心入口，結合其廣大 PC 用戶基礎與雲端基礎建設，促使使用者更容易採用 Azure、Microsoft 365 以及 AI 驅動的 Copilot，從而提升整體雲端與 Copilot 服務的參與度。

[MSFT 10-K period 2025] For enterprises, digital technology empowers employees, optimizes operations, engages customers, and in some cases, changes the very core of products and services. The Microsoft Cloud provides integration across the technology stack while offering openness, improving time to value, reducing costs, and increasing agility. Our cloud business benefits from three economies of scale: datacenters that deploy computational resources at significantly lower cost per unit than smaller ones; datacenters that coordinate and aggregate diverse customer, geographic, and application demand patterns, improving the utilization of computing, storage, and network resources; and multi-tenancy locations that lower application maintenance labor costs. We prioritize security above all else and we offer our customers integrated AI-driven products addressing security, compliance, identity, management, and privacy across customers’ multi-cloud, application, and device assets. The Ambitions That Drive Us

To achieve our vision, our research and development efforts focus on three interconnected ambitions:

•Reinvent productivity and business processes to help organizations and individuals work and collaborate more securely and efficiently. •Build the intelligent cloud and intelligent edge platform to provide a foundation for our customers’ digital workloads including hybrid consistency, developer productivity, data and AI capabilities, and trusted security and compliance. •Create more personal computing to enable users to interact with technology in more intuitive, engaging, and dynamic ways. Our Future Opportunity

We are focused on helping customers use the breadth and depth of the Microsoft Cloud to get the most value out of their digital spend while leading the AI platform wave across our solution areas. We continue to develop complete, intelligent solutions for our customers that empower people to be productive and collaborate, while safeguarding businesses and simplifying IT management. Our goal is to lead the industry in several distinct areas of technology over the long term, which we expect will translate to sustained growth. We are investing significant resources in:

•Transforming the workplace to deliver new, modern, modular business applications, drive deeper insights, and improve how people communicate, collaborate, learn, work, and interact with one another. •Building and running cloud-based services in ways that utilize ubiquitous computing to unleash new experiences and opportunities for businesses and individuals. •Applying AI and ambient intelligence to drive insights, revolutionize many types of work and business processes, and provide substantive productivity gains using Microsoft 365 Copilot and agents. •Providing training on generative AI and greater access to digital learning and resources through skilling programs and initiatives, grants, and LinkedIn learning pathways. •Inventing new gaming experiences that bring people together around their shared love for games on any device and pushing the boundaries of innovation with console and PC gaming. •Leveraging Windows to fuel our cloud business, grow our share of the PC market, and drive increased engagement with our services like Microsoft Edge, Bing, Copilot, Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365 Consumer, Xbox Game Pass, and more. •Tackling security from all angles with our integrated, end-to-end solutions spanning security, compliance, identity, and management, across all clouds and platforms. Our future growth depends on our ability to transcend current product category definitions, business models, and sales motions. Commitment to Sustainability

Microsoft is committed to sustainability and our approach to addressing climate change starts with the sustainability of our own business. In 2020, we announced goals to become a carbon negative, water positive, and zero waste company by 2030. Since announcing these goals, we have made meaningful progress while having seen major changes in both the technology sector and in our understanding of what it will take to meet our goals.

Amazon 正在透過擴大 AWS 基礎設施與直接投資 Anthropic 的股權與融資安排，來加速其 AI 與機器學習服務的長期成長。  

- **AWS 與技術基礎設施的整體投資**：Amazon 表示會持續增加科技與基礎設施支出，以支援人工智慧與機器學習計畫，並將此類成本分配至各事業部使用【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #198】。2025 年因基礎設施（含折舊與攤銷）支出上升，導致科技與基礎設施成本較前一年增加，外匯變動亦使成本上升 3.12 億美元（$312 million）【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #215】；2026 年第一季因基礎設施支出（含折舊與攤銷）上升，成本較去年同期增加，外匯影響 3.74 億美元（$374 million）【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #78】。公司亦說明這些投資包括伺服器、網路設備、資料中心折舊與攤銷，以及支援 AWS 的其他硬體與軟體基礎設施【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #215】【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #78】。  

- **AI 與機器學習相關支出**：在 2025 年的說明中，Amazon 明確指出「支援人工智慧與機器學習的基礎設施與員工」將持續增加，屬於未來支出增長的主要驅動力【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #198】；2026 年第一季亦重申將因 AI/ML 計畫而提升相關支出【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #78】。  

- **與 Anthropic 的股權投資**：Amazon 在 2025 年第三季將部分可轉換公司債投資於 Anthropic 轉換為非投票優先股，因而在 Q3 2025 產生 23 億美元（$2.3 billion） 的可供出售債券公允價值調整收益，九個月累計則為 56 億美元（$5.6 billion）【AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #33】。同期間，因 Anthropic 非投票優先股價格變動，Amazon 於 Q3 2025 認列 72 億美元（$7.2 billion） 的股權投資上漲，九個月累計 73 億美元（$7.3 billion）【AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #33】。  

- **Anthropic 持股規模與後續投資**：截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，Amazon 持有的 Anthropic 非投票優先股公允價值約為 148 億美元（$14.8 billion）；至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，該金額增至約 320 億美元（$32.0 billion）【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40】。此外，Amazon 在 2026 年第一季後投資了額外 50 億美元（$5.0 billion） 於 Anthropic 的非投票優先股【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40】。  

- **融資安排與未來承諾**：Amazon 為 Anthropic 設立了一筆最高 200 億美元（$20.0 billion） 的融資設施，於 30 個月內於 Anthropic 完成首次公開發行或直接上市等流動性事件後可供提取；目前尚未提取任何金額【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40】。同時，Amazon 擁有額外最高 50 億美元（$5.0 billion） 的選擇權，可於 Anthropic 未來的股權融資中投入，以減少該融資設施的可用額度【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40】。  

- **策略整合**：上述股權與融資投入被納入 Amazon 的「技術與基礎設施」投資框架，旨在透過擴充 AWS 計算、儲存與 AI 服務能力，提升客戶使用體驗並支撐長期成長【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #198】。公司亦強調會「有效率」地投資於多項技術領域，包括 AWS、衛星寬頻與自動駕駛車輛，以確保在 AI 與雲端市場的競爭優勢【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #198】。  

總結而言，Amazon 透過持續擴大 AWS 基礎設施、加大 AI/ML 相關支出，並以可轉換債券轉為非投票優先股、直接投入資金以及提供大型融資設施的方式，深度參與 Anthropic 的發展，將此視為支撐其長期 AI 成長與雲端服務領導地位的核心策略。

records.query: Amazon 在 AWS、Prime 與電商業務上面臨哪些反壟斷或監管風險？
records.answer:
Amazon 正在面臨多項針對其 AWS 雲端服務、Prime 會員以及電商平台的反壟斷與監管調查，這些調查可能導致巨額罰款、合規成本上升、營運模式被迫改變，甚至抑制國際成長。  

- **AWS 雲端服務**：美國證券文件指出，亞馬遜正受到「開放調查」指稱其 AWS 服務可能違反競爭相關或消費者保護規則，且公司正積極爭辯這些指控【AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #108】、【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #156】、【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #113】。  
- **Prime 會員與電商平台（包括實體店鋪、履行網路）**：同樣的文件透露，調查亦涵蓋 Amazon 的實體店鋪運營、履行網路以及 Prime 服務，指稱這些業務可能侵犯競爭或消費者保護法規【AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #108】、【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #156】、【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #113】。  
- **資料隱私與資料使用**：公司同時面臨「日益增長的」資料收集、使用與揭露相關法律與規範的調查，這些調查的結果亦可能影響其整體營運與合規成本【AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #108】、【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #156】。  
- **「門檻者」監管與合規成本**：監管機構與立法者正將 Amazon 列為線上「門檻者」(gatekeeper)，透過既有法規與新法規加強管制，這將提升公司的合規支出，並可能限制其業務操作【AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #108】、【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #156】。  
- **潛在後果**：文件警示，若不利的規範、法律或執法行動成立，Amazon 可能面臨「實質成本」與「巨額金錢罰款」、民事或刑事責任、需求或服務可得性下降、營運成本上升、必須改變商業慣例、聲譽受損、成長受阻等多重負面影響【AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #108】、【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #156】。  

綜合以上，Amazon 在 AWS、Prime 以及整體電商業務上均受到反壟斷與多層次監管風險的挑戰，且這些風險已被正式披露於其 2025/2025‑09/2026‑03 期間的 10‑Q 與 10‑K 報告中。

records.query: Google 如何把 Gemini AI 整合進搜尋與其他產品生態系？
records.answer:
Google 透過在搜尋、專屬應用、雲端服務與消費者訂閱等多個核心產品中嵌入 Gemini 系列大型語言模型，讓 AI 功能成為整個生態系的基礎技術。[GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]  

- **搜尋（Google Search）**：在搜尋體驗中加入 Gemini 3 的多模態與推理能力，推出 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode，讓使用者可以以自然語言提問並得到更具深度與互動性的回應，這些功能皆以 Gemini 的先進推理與多模態技術為支撐。[GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132]  

- **Gemini App**：Gemini 3 直接整合於 Gemini 應用程式，提供使用者即時的生成式 AI 互動體驗，並支援視覺化與互動式使用情境，與搜尋等其他產品形成互補。[GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]  

- **Google Cloud 服務**：針對企業客戶，Google Cloud 以「Gemini Enterprise」與「Gemini for Google Workspace」兩項解決方案，將 Gemini AI 的算力與模型能力嵌入基礎設施、平台與應用層，協助客戶在雲端環境中使用生成式 AI、資料分析與安全服務。[GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]  

- **消費者訂閱（Google One）**：Google One 訂閱服務提供用戶存取最先進的 Gemini 模型，使個人使用者也能直接受惠於高階 AI 功能。[GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #134]  

- **產品覆蓋範圍**：Alphabet 表示其 15 個擁有超過五億使用者的產品（其中七個產品使用者超過二十億）皆已採用 Gemini 模型，顯示 Gemini 已深入公司主要產品與平台的每一層。[GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]  

透過上述多點佈局，Google 把 Gemini AI 從搜尋核心功能延伸至應用程式、企業雲端服務與消費者訂閱，形成一條完整的 AI 生態鏈，讓使用者與企業在不同情境下皆能即時獲得生成式 AI 的價值。

records.query: Meta 在 AI 與 Reality Labs 上的長期願景與投資方向是什麼？
records.answer:
Meta 的長期願景是將 AI、可穿戴裝置與虛擬/增強實境結合，打造「下一代計算平台」與沉浸式的元宇宙體驗，同時持續投入巨額資金於 Reality Labs 相關研發與營運。[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #175]  

- **願景說明**：Meta 認為元宇宙是「下一階段的社交科技」；自 2021 年起，策略聚焦於 AI、可穿戴裝置與裝置介面，以支援新興的虛擬與增強實境技術，並預期此項計畫將是「複雜、持續演變且長期」的倡議。[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #175]  
- **AI 投資方向**：公司持續「開發與訓練 AI 模型」並計畫「持續增加這些投資」；AI 玻璃（如 Ray‑Ban Meta、Oakley Meta）內建 Meta AI 對話助理，並推出結合顯示屏的 Meta Ray‑Ban Display 以及利用肌電訊號控制的 Meta Neural Band，顯示其在 AI 可穿戴領域的產品化路徑。[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131]、[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #188]  
- **Reality Labs 營運支出分配**：在 2026 年，Meta 預計將約 **70%** 的 Reality Labs 營運費用投入於可穿戴裝置（wearables）計畫，剩餘 **30%** 用於 VR 與 Horizon（元宇宙平台）相關項目。[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #132]  
- **財務影響**：Reality Labs 的重大投資已導致 2025 年整體營運利潤下降約 **191.9 億美元（$19.19 billion）**，且預期 2026 年的 Reality Labs 營運虧損將與 2025 年相似，顯示公司願意在短期內承受盈餘壓縮，以換取長期技術布局。[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #188]  
- **產品路線圖**：Meta 現行 VR 產品包括 Meta Quest 系列與 Horizon Store 內容；可穿戴方面則有 AI 眼鏡、2024 年推出的 Orion 原型（真實 AR 眼鏡）以及 2025 年的 Meta Ray‑Ban Display，這些都是支撐其「下一代介面」與元宇宙生態系的具體實踐。[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131]  

綜合以上，Meta 的長期願景是以 AI 與可穿戴技術為核心，透過 Reality Labs 持續投入研發與營運資源，打造結合虛擬與增強實境的元宇宙平台，即使短期內會削減營運利潤，也視為實現長遠「下一代計算平台」的必要步驟。[META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #72]

records.query: Meta 的廣告獲利模式與 Meta AI 在旗下 App 中扮演的角色是什麼？
records.answer:
Meta 主要透過在 Facebook、Instagram、Messenger 等「Family of Apps」上販售廣告版位，以每千次曝光（impression）或每次使用者執行特定動作（click、action）收費，並在廣告實際展示或使用者完成動作的當期確認收入；同時，Meta AI 作為跨平台的智慧助理，嵌入所有 App（包括 Facebook、Instagram、Messenger、Threads、WhatsApp）以及獨立應用與 AI 眼鏡，提供內容排序、推薦、廣告工具及生成式 AI 體驗，提升使用者互動與廣告效能【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #311】、【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】、【META_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2】。

- **廣告獲利模式**  
  1. **廣告版位與收費方式**：Meta 依據廣告在 Feed、Reels、Stories、Messenger 等位置的展示次數（impression）或使用者執行的特定行動（action）向廣告主收費【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #311】。  
  2. **收入確認時點**：對於以曝光計價的廣告，Meta 在廣告被展示的合約期間確認收入；對於以行動計價的廣告，則在使用者完成該行動的期間確認收入【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #311】。  
  3. **平均每則廣告價格**：Meta 以「總廣告收入 ÷ 投放廣告數量」計算每則廣告的平均價格，這個指標反映廣告主為每則廣告（不論是曝光或行動）所支付的平均金額【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #311】。  
  4. **廣告展示頻率與產品差異**：Meta 會根據產品（例如 Video、Reels 與 Feed、Stories）調整廣告展示的數量與頻率，且不同產品的變現率不盡相同【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #311】。  
  5. **廣告收入的淨額認列**：若廣告收入安排中 Meta 不是主要方，則以淨額方式認列收入【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #311】。

- **Meta AI 在 App 中的角色**  
  1. **跨平台助理**：Meta AI 以助理形式出現在所有主要 App（Facebook、Instagram、Messenger、Threads、WhatsApp）以及獨立的 Meta AI 應用、AI 眼鏡與網路平台，協助使用者學習、完成任務、創作內容並促進連結【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】、【META_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2】。  
  2. **內容排序與推薦**：Meta AI 為各 App 的內容排序系統與發現引擎提供動能，讓使用者看到更相關的貼文與影片，間接提升廣告的目標精準度【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。  
  3. **廣告工具與創新體驗**：Meta AI 支援廣告主使用的工具，協助其更有效地觸及目標客群，同時也驅動生成式 AI 體驗（如自動生成文字、影像）以及提升產品開發效率【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。  
  4. **硬體整合**：在 AI 眼鏡（Ray‑Ban Meta、Oakley Meta）與未來的 AR 眼鏡中，Meta AI 內建於裝置，提供語音助理與手勢控制功能，擴展了其在硬體層面的應用範圍【META_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2】。  

總結來說，Meta 透過以曝光或行動為基礎的廣告銷售模式直接創造營收，並利用 Meta AI 在所有產品中的深度整合，提升內容相關性、廣告效能與使用者體驗，形成廣告與 AI 互相增強的生態系統。

Components of Results of Operations

Revenue

Family of Apps (FoA)

records.query: Tesla 如何把自動駕駛（FSD/Autopilot）技術當作與競爭對手的核心差異化？
records.answer:
Tesla 以自家研發的全自動駕駛（FSD/Autopilot）與 AI 能力作為核心差異化，透過專屬的視覺感測技術、客製化推論晶片、全車 OTA 軟體更新以及從設計階段即為自動駕駛而建的車輛平台，讓其在自動駕駛與 Robotaxi 市場上與競爭者形成明顯的技術與使用者體驗優勢。  

- Tesla 表示「每一台交付的車輛皆為自動駕駛而設計」，並認為「我們的 AI 能力與進步使我們在競爭者中脫穎而出」[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。  
- 公司使用「視覺為基礎的技術、系統與軟體」來訓練人工神經網路，並以「自家設計的客製化推論晶片」加速運算，這些硬體與演算法的結合被視為自動駕駛的關鍵競爭力 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。  
- 透過「空中（over‑the‑air）軟體更新」持續改進自動駕駛功能與車內資訊娛樂系統，使 Tesla 能在不需實體回廠的情況下快速迭代與提升功能，進一步強化與其他僅靠硬體升級的競爭者的差異 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。  
- 在公司使命與策略說明中，Tesla 強調「工程專業知識、真實世界 AI 的進展、垂直整合的營運模式」以及「以使用者體驗為核心」的差異化因素，這些皆與其自動駕駛軟硬體整合緊密相關 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #30]。  
- 雖然 Tesla 承認在 AI 與機器人領域面臨既有與新興公司的競爭，但其核心競爭優勢仍聚焦於「產品規格與功能、強大的品牌」以及「模組化、可擴展的能源儲存」等，對於自動駕駛本身的差異化說法則主要來自上述 AI 與硬體整合的描述，而非能源儲存本身 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #51]。  

綜合上述，Tesla 透過自有的 AI 演算法、視覺感測硬體、專屬推論晶片與 OTA 軟體平台，將 FSD/Autopilot 打造成與競爭對手明顯區隔的核心技術與服務。

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] We have planned electric vehicles to address additional vehicle markets, and will continue leveraging developments in our proprietary Full Self-Driving (“FSD”) (Supervised) features, battery cell and other technologies. For purposes of this filing, use of the term “FSD (Supervised)” includes the equivalent naming convention, “FSD (Capability)” that is used in the European, Middle East and Asia-Pacific regions. In June 2025, we launched our Robotaxi service, an autonomous ride-hailing platform that harnesses our technology and vehicles. We expect this service will open access to an expanded customer base as modes of transportation evolve, and, along with products such as FSD (Supervised) subscriptions, unlock the potential to advance a service-driven business model based on AI, software and fleet-based profits. Our Robotaxi business currently operates with Model Y vehicles but, in time, will include Cybercab, our purpose-built autonomous vehicle. Energy Generation and Storage

Energy Storage Products

Powerwall and Megapack are our lithium-ion battery energy storage products. Powerwall, which we sell and lease to customers, as well as through channel partners, is designed to store energy at homes or small commercial facilities. Megapack is an energy storage solution for commercial, industrial, utility and energy generation customers, multiple of which may be grouped together to form larger installations of gigawatt hours (“GWh”) or greater capacity. As AI infrastructure drives rapid load growth, Megapack helps to, among other things, increase utilization of existing generation and transmission capacity, resulting in a more efficient use of the electric grid. We also continue to develop software capabilities for remotely controlling and dispatching our energy storage systems across a wide range of markets and applications, including through our real-time energy control and optimization platforms for Megapack batteries (Autobidder) and distributed energy resources like Powerwall (Powerhub). Energy Generation Offerings

We sell energy generation systems directly to customers and also through channel partners. We design and manufacture certain components for our energy generation products, including solar panels and Solar Roof, which combines premium glass roof tiles with energy generation. We also purchase many components for our energy generation systems from various third-party manufacturers to provide for competitive pricing and adequate supply. Technology

Automotive

Self-Driving Development and Artificial Intelligence 

We use AI to develop real-world applications, such as autonomous driving solutions and robots. We utilize vision-based technologies, systems and software to train our artificial neural networks, which are accelerated by our own in-house, custom designed inference chips. We are also applying our artificial intelligence learnings from self-driving technology to Bots, such as Optimus, a general purpose, autonomous humanoid robot in development. Currently, we offer in our customer vehicles certain advanced driver assistance systems. Although at present, same as in the past, the driver is responsible for remaining fully engaged in the driving operation, these systems provide safety and convenience functionality that may relieve drivers of many tedious and potentially dangerous aspects of road travel much like the system that airplane pilots use, when conditions permit. As with other vehicle systems, we improve these functions in our customer vehicles through over-the-air software updates. Every Tesla vehicle delivered today is designed for autonomy, and we believe our capabilities and advancements in AI differentiate us from our competitors. Vehicle Control and Infotainment Software

The performance and safety systems of our vehicles and their battery packs utilize sophisticated control software. Control systems in our vehicles optimize performance, customize vehicle behavior, manage charging and control all infotainment functions. We develop almost all of this software, including most of the user interfaces, internally and update our vehicles’ software regularly through over-the-air updates, and work to actively improve our software security with every release. Battery and Powertrain

Our core vehicle technology competencies include powertrain engineering and manufacturing and our ability to design vehicles that utilize the unique advantages of an electric powertrain. We have designed our proprietary powertrain systems to be adaptable, efficient, reliable and cost-effective while withstanding the rigors of an automotive environment. We offer dual motor powertrain vehicles, which use two electric motors to maximize traction and performance in an all-wheel drive configuration, as well as vehicle powertrain technology featuring three electric motors for further increased performance in certain versions of Model S and Model X, Cybertruck and the Tesla Semi. We maintain extensive testing and R&D capabilities for battery cells, packs and systems, and have built an expansive body of knowledge on lithium-ion cell chemistry types and performance characteristics.

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] As we seek to become a top provider of autonomous solutions, we also face competition in the fields of AI and robotics. We expect our Robotaxi service to compete in this developing market, along with traditional ride-hailing and taxi services, through continued progress on our FSD (Supervised) and neural network capabilities, Supercharger network and infotainment offerings. Energy Generation and Storage

Energy Storage Systems

The market for energy storage products and services is also highly competitive, and both established and emerging companies have introduced products and services that are similar to our product portfolio or that are alternatives to the elements of our systems or software service offerings. We compete with these companies based on price, energy density, efficiency, optimization and performance. We believe that the specifications and features of our products, our strong brand and the modular, scalable nature of our energy storage products give us a competitive advantage in our markets. 10


Energy Generation Systems

The primary competitors to our energy generation business are the traditional local utility companies that supply energy to our potential customers. We compete with these traditional utility companies primarily based on price and the ease by which customers can switch to electricity generated by our energy generation systems. We also compete with solar energy companies that provide products and services similar to ours. Many solar energy companies only install solar energy systems, while others only provide financing for these installations. We believe we have a significant expansion opportunity with our offerings, including in terms of the aesthetics, superior performance and ease of installation and integration with Powerwall of our solar panels, and that the environment is increasingly conducive to the adoption of renewable energy systems. Intellectual Property

We place a strong emphasis on our innovative approach and proprietary designs which bring intrinsic value and uniqueness to our product portfolio. As part of our business, we seek to protect the underlying intellectual property rights of these innovations and designs such as with respect to patents, trademarks, copyrights, trade secrets, confidential information and other measures, including through employee and third-party nondisclosure agreements and other contractual arrangements. For example, we place a high priority on obtaining patents to provide the broadest and strongest possible protection to enable our freedom to operate our innovations and designs across all of our products and technologies as well as to protect and defend our product portfolio. We have also adopted a patent policy in which we irrevocably pledged that we will not initiate a lawsuit against any party for infringing our patents through activity relating to electric vehicles or related equipment for so long as such party is acting in good faith. We made this pledge in order to encourage the advancement of a common, rapidly-evolving platform for electric vehicles, thereby benefiting ourselves, other companies making electric vehicles and the world. Human Capital Resources 

Tesla’s ability to attract, develop and retain a talented workforce is a competitive advantage. As of December 31, 2025, our employee headcount worldwide was 134,785.

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] ITEM 1. BUSINESS

Overview

We are focused on bringing artificial intelligence (“AI”) into the real world, through products and services like Full Self-Driving (“FSD”) (Supervised) and Robotaxi, as well as working to develop and commercialize AI robots (“Bots”) (including Optimus). We intend to leverage our current operations, in which we design, develop, manufacture, sell and lease high-performance fully electric vehicles and energy generation and storage systems that increasingly deliver AI-related and enhanced software and services to our customers, to achieve that objective. We generally sell our products directly to customers, and continue to grow our global retail, service and charging footprint to accelerate the widespread adoption of our products. We emphasize performance, attractive styling and the safety of our users and workforce in the design and manufacture of our products and are continuing to develop full self-driving technology for improved safety. We also strive to lower the cost of ownership for our customers through continuous efforts to reduce manufacturing costs and by offering financial and other services tailored to our products. Our mission is building a world of amazing abundance. We believe that this mission, along with our engineering expertise, advancements in real-world AI, vertically integrated business model, and focus on user experience differentiate us from other companies. Segment Information

We operate as two reportable segments: (i) automotive and (ii) energy generation and storage. The automotive segment includes the design, development, manufacturing, sales and leasing of high-performance fully electric vehicles as well as sales of automotive regulatory credits. Additionally, the automotive segment also includes services and other, which includes sales of used vehicles, non-warranty maintenance services and collision, paid Supercharging sessions, automotive insurance business revenue, part sales and retail merchandise sales. The energy generation and storage segment includes sales, leasing, and financing of energy generation and storage products, services related to such products and sales of energy generation incentives. Our Products and Services

Automotive

We currently manufacture five different consumer vehicles – the Model 3, Y, S, X and Cybertruck. Model 3 is a four-door mid-size sedan that we designed for manufacturability with a base price for mass-market appeal. Model Y is a compact sport utility vehicle (“SUV”) built on the Model 3 platform with seating for up to seven adults. Model S is a four-door full-size sedan and Model X is a mid-size SUV with seating for up to seven adults. Model S and Model X feature the highest performance characteristics and longest ranges that we offer in a sedan and SUV, respectively. The Cybertruck is a full-size electric pickup truck with a stainless steel exterior that has the utility and strength of a truck while featuring the speed of a sports car. In 2022, we also began early production and deliveries of a commercial electric vehicle, the Tesla Semi.

records.query: Tesla 在電動車市場面臨什麼樣的競爭態勢？
records.answer:
Tesla 在電動車市場面臨「高度競爭且持續升溫」的局面，來自既有大型汽車廠與新進電動車／自動駕駛公司雙重壓力。 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66]  

- 競爭對手包括「已建立資源且規模更大」的傳統汽車製造商，以及「新興與新成立」的電動與替代燃料車廠，這些公司正投入設計、開發、製造、行銷與售後服務，可能取得成本優勢或地緣利益，導致 Tesla 的車輛單位銷售、價格、營收與市場佔有率受壓。 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66]  
- 在各細分車型上，Tesla 的產品直接與多個細分市場的競爭者較勁：Cybertruck 與其他皮卡競爭；Model S、Model X 與高階轎車與豪華 SUV 競爭；Model 3、Model Y 與小型至中型轎車與緊湊 SUV 競爭，這些市場本身「極度競爭」且多為內燃機車廠的傳統領域。 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #50]  
- 競爭產品主要是「內燃機車」以及「混合動力與插電式混合動力」車款，且越來越多既有與新興廠商已推出或計畫推出電動車，進一步提升電動車市場的競爭激烈度。 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #50]  
- 除了車輛本身，Tesla 亦面臨在「自動駕駛解決方案」上的激烈競爭，若自動駕駛的採用率未如預期，將直接影響其營運與財務表現。 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66]  
- 在能源產業方面，Tesla 的「能源發電與儲能」業務也遭受其他製造商、開發商、安裝商與大型公用事業公司的競爭，且電價下降可能削弱其產品吸引力。 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66]  
- 另外，Tesla 正在開發的「Bots（包括 Optimus）」亦面臨來自其他公司在機器人領域的設計、開發與製造競爭，若該業務未能如預期成長，亦可能對整體營運造成衝擊。 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66]  

綜合以上，Tesla 在電動車市場的競爭態勢是「多層次、跨領域且資源密集」的挑戰，涵蓋傳統汽車、電動車新進者、自動駕駛技術、能源儲存與機器人等多個面向。

records.query: Tesla 的能源生成與儲能業務在公司整體策略中扮演什麼角色？
records.answer:
Tesla 把能源生成與儲能業務視為公司產品組合的一環，藉由既有製造規模與技術優勢，協助實現長期獲利成長【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #115】。  

- **業務定位**：能源生成與儲能被列為公司兩大主要營運部門之一，與汽車部門平行，提供太陽能板、Solar Roof、Powerwall、Megapack 等產品與相關服務【TSLA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2】。  
- **技術互補**：能源儲存產品採用來自車輛的元件技術，採模組化電池設計以提升製造彈性，同時結合公司在電力電子與 AI 軟體（如 Powerhub、Autobidder）上的專長，讓儲能系統可遠端控制、即時調度【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #32】。  
- **產品開發**：2025 年開始量產全新住宅翻新太陽能板，並於 2026 年 1 月開始交付；Solar Roof 亦持續製造，並以自家太陽能逆變器與 Powerwall 整合，提升發電效率【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #32】。  
- **營運規模**：2025 年公司部署了 46.7 GWh 的能源儲存產品，顯示該業務已具相當規模【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #115】。  
- **策略角色**：在 2025 年的 10‑K 中，Tesla 強調透過「差異化且有效管理的產品組合」來追求獲利成長，能源生成與儲能產品被納入此組合，與汽車、FSD、Robotaxi 等業務共同提升產能利用率、降低成本，並擴大服務與充電基礎設施【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #115】。  

綜合上述，能源生成與儲能業務不僅是獨立的營收來源，更透過技術共享、軟體平台與基礎設施投資，與汽車與自動駕駛服務形成互補，成為 Tesla 整體長期成長與獲利策略的重要組成部分。

records.query: Apple 自己在 10-K 中如何描述它在智慧型手機、PC、平板市場面臨的競爭壓力與市佔地位？
records.answer:
Apple 在 10‑K 中指出，它在智慧型手機、個人電腦與平板電腦等全球市場僅佔少數市場份額，且面臨來自資源豐富、技術、行銷與分銷能力強大的競爭者的強大壓力【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】。  

- Apple 認為競爭者擁有龐大的客戶基礎、完整的硬體與軟體產品線，且能以低價甚至虧本的方式提供產品，導致價格與毛利率持續被壓低【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】。  
- 競爭者常模仿 Apple 的產品功能與設計，甚至合作提供整合解決方案，進一步加劇市場競爭【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】。  
- 因此 Apple 在智慧型手機、個人電腦、平板與可穿戴裝置等市場的市佔率被描述為「少數」或「少量」的市場份額【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】。  
- 部分市場有時甚至出現「幾乎沒有成長」或「整體收縮」的情況，進一步提升了競爭的挑戰性【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】。

records.query: Apple 的第三方開發者生態系相對於 Android、Windows 等平台的黏著度是如何建立的？
records.answer:
Apple 透過讓開發者感受到在 iOS 與 macOS 平台上可獲得較高的營收潛力、未來產品銷售成長預期與相對合理的開發成本，來提升第三方開發者對其生態系的黏著度【Reference 4: AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #110】。  

- 開發者是否願意投入 Apple 平台，取決於與 Android、Windows、PlayStation、Nintendo、Xbox 等競爭平台相比，所感受到的「利益」——包括 Apple 產品的市場定位、預期可產生的收入、未來銷售成長以及開發成本等因素【Reference 4: AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #110】。  
- 即使 Apple 在全球智慧手機、個人電腦、平板與穿戴裝置的市佔率相對較低，仍必須透過提升平台吸引力，使開發者不因「市場規模較小」而轉向競爭平台【Reference 4: AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #110】。  
- Apple 依賴持續提供「具吸引力且創新」的軟體應用與服務，才能確保開發者持續投入與維護其產品，避免因技術變化或開發者資源重新分配而失去應用程式供給【Reference 4: AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #110】。  
- 因此，Apple 透過強調其平台的高價值使用者基礎、穩定的收入模型與持續的產品創新，來建立並維持開發者對 iOS 與 macOS 生態系的黏著度【Reference 4: AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #110】。

records.query: Microsoft More Personal Computing 部門最新一季營收表現如何？哪些因素互相抵銷？
records.answer:
Microsoft More Personal Computing 部門在最新一季（截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日的三個月）營收為 **131.92 億美元（$13.192 billion）**，較去年同期 **133.71 億美元（$13.371 billion）** 下降約 **1%**【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #104】。  

- 這季營收「相對持平」的說法來自公司說明，指出 Windows 與 Devices 的收入略有提升，而 Gaming 收入下降 **11 億美元（$1.1 billion）**（‑6%），Search 廣告收入則上升 **10 億美元（$1.0 billion）**（+10%）【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #111】。  
- 同時，另一段文字指出 More Personal Computing 營收因 Devices 與 Gaming 硬體銷售下降而減少，但部分被 Search 廣告的成長所抵銷【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #102】。  

因此，營收的微幅下降主要是 **硬體（Devices、Gaming）銷售下滑** 抵消了 **Windows/Devices 小幅增長** 與 **Search 廣告收入的顯著提升**。

Cost of sales primarily consists of the purchase price of consumer products, inbound and outbound shipping costs, including costs related to sortation and delivery centers and where we are the transportation service provider, and digital media content costs where we record revenue gross, including video and music. The increase in cost of sales in Q1 2026, compared to the comparable prior year period, is primarily due to increased product and shipping costs resulting from increased sales, partially offset by operational efficiencies. Shipping costs to receive products from our suppliers are included in our inventory and recognized as cost of sales upon sale of products to our customers. We expect our cost of shipping to continue to increase to the extent our customers accept and use our shipping offers at an increasing rate, we use more expensive shipping methods, and we offer additional services. We seek to mitigate costs of shipping over time in part through achieving higher sales volumes, optimizing our fulfillment network, negotiating better terms with our suppliers, and achieving better operating efficiencies. We believe that offering low prices to our customers is fundamental to our future success, and one way we offer lower prices is through shipping offers. Google Cloud 在最新一季（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的三個月）營收較去年同期增長約 **82%**，從約 **136 億美元（$13.6 billion）** 提升至約 **248 億美元（$24.8 billion）**，增幅為 **111 億美元（$11.1 billion）**【GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #47】。  

- 三個月結束於 2025 年 6 月 30 日的 Google Cloud 營收為 **136.24 億美元（$13,624 million）**（即 136 億美元（$13.6 billion））【GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #47】。  
- 同期於 2026 年 6 月 30 日的 Google Cloud 營收為 **247.68 億美元（$24,768 million）**（即 248 億美元（$24.8 billion））【GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #47】。  
- 兩期之間的絕對增長為 **111 億美元（$11.1 billion）**（$24,768 m – $13,624 m）【GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #47】。  
- 以去年同期為基礎計算，增長率為 **(111.44 億美元（$11,144 million） ÷ 136.24 億美元（$13,624 million）) ≈ 81.9%**，四捨五入即約 **82%**。  

因此，Google Cloud 最新一季的營收成長約為 82%。

records.query: Google 收購 Wiz 花了多少錢？這如何影響 Google Cloud 部門？
records.answer:
Google 於 2026 年 3 月 11 日完成對 Wiz 的收購，花費約 **295 億美元**，此交易已納入 Google Cloud 部門的合併財務報表中【GOOGL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #77】。  

- 收購金額在 10‑Q 中具體列為 **295 億美元（$29.5 billion）**，並說明此投資旨在加速 Google Cloud 在多雲與 AI 驅動的安全領域的能力【GOOGL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #77】。  
- 交易的購買價格分配顯示：無形資產 **83 億美元（$8,300 million）**、商譽 **227.05 億美元（$22,705 million）**、假設的淨負債 **(15.38 億美元（$1,538 million）)**，合計 **294.67 億美元（$29,467 million）**（即約 295 億美元（$29.5 billion））【GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #94】。  
- 收購完成後，Wiz 的財務結果被納入 Google Cloud 部門的合併財務報表，並在該部門內記錄相關的商譽與無形資產【GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #94】。  
- 這筆收購被描述為「Google Cloud 投資，以加速我們在多雲與人工智慧驅動的安全方面的能力」，顯示其戰略目的是提升雲端安全服務的競爭力【GOOGL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #77】。

records.query: Meta 最新一季總營收成長多少？主要驅動因素是什麼？
records.answer:
Meta 在最新一季（2026 年第一季）總營收較去年同期成長約 **33%**，從 423.14 億美元（$42,314 百萬）提升至 563.11 億美元（$56,311 百萬）【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #0】。  

主要驅動因素包括：  
1. **廣告收入大幅提升**，廣告營收增加 136.3 億美元（$13.63 billion），成長 33%，主要來自廣告曝光量上升 19% 以及每則廣告平均價格上升 12%【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #226】。  
2. **非廣告收入（FoA other）顯著成長**，因 WhatsApp 付費訊息與 Meta Verified 訂閱帶動，收入增加 3.75 億美元（$375 million），成長 74%【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #226】。  
3. **Reality Labs（RL）收入略微下降**，僅減少 0.1 億美元（$10 million）（2%），對總營收貢獻較小【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #226】。  

綜合以上，廣告曝光與單價的雙重提升，以及付費訊息與訂閱服務的快速成長，是本季營收增長的核心動力。

Trends in Our Revenue by User Geography 

We calculate our revenue by user geography based on our estimate of the geography in which ad impressions are delivered, virtual and digital goods are purchased, or consumer hardware products are shipped. The geography of our users affects our revenue and financial results. Our revenue in regions such as United States & Canada and Europe is relatively higher primarily due to the size and maturity of those online and mobile advertising markets, and ad impression growth is primarily in geographies that monetize at lower rates, such as Asia-Pacific. In the first quarter of 2026, revenue increased by 29% in United States & Canada, 39% in Europe, 29% in Asia-Pacific, and 40% in Rest of World, in each case relative to the same period in 2025. -

Our revenue by user geography in the charts above is geographically apportioned based on our estimation of the geographic location of our users when they perform a revenue-generating activity.

[META 10-Q period 202603] Advertising

Advertising revenue in the three months ended March 31, 2026 increased $13.63 billion, or 33%, compared to the same period in 2025, due to increases in ad impressions delivered and average price per ad. During the three months ended March 31, 2026, ad impressions delivered increased by 19%, year-over-year, as compared with an increase of 5% in the same period in 2025. Ad impressions delivered during the three months ended March 31, 2026 grew in all regions, especially in Asia-Pacific, which was driven by increases in users and their engagement as well as the frequency of ads shown on our products. During the three months ended March 31, 2026, the average price per ad increased by 12%, year-over-year, as compared with an increase of 10% in the same period in 2025. The increase in average price per ad in the three months ended March 31, 2026 was driven by an increase in advertising demand, which we believe is mostly due to ongoing improvements to our ad performance from our ad targeting and measurement tools, and a favorable foreign currency exchange impact. This increase was partially offset by a higher number of ad impressions delivered, especially in geographies and in products, such as Reels, that monetize at lower rates. Other factors are discussed in the section entitled "—Executive Overview of First Quarter Results." In addition, the online commerce vertical was the largest contributor to the increase in advertising revenue in the three months ended March 31, 2026 compared to the same period in 2025. We anticipate that future advertising revenue will be driven by a combination of price and ad impressions delivered. Other revenue

FoA other revenue in the three months ended March 31, 2026 increased $375 million, or 74%, compared to the same period in 2025. The increase was mostly driven by paid messaging from WhatsApp and Meta Verified subscriptions. Reality Labs

RL revenue in the three months ended March 31, 2026 decreased $10 million, or 2%, compared to the same period in 2025. The decrease was driven by lower Meta Quest sales, offset by an increase in sales of AI glasses. Foreign Exchange Impact on Revenue

Changes in foreign exchange rates had a favorable impact on our revenue in the three months ended March 31, 2026 compared to the same period in 2025. [NVDA 10-Q period 202604] Concentration of Revenue

We refer to customers who purchase products directly from NVIDIA as direct customers, such as AIBs, distributors, ODMs, OEMs, CSPs, AI model makers, and system integrators. Our revenue is concentrated among a limited number of direct and indirect customers and this trend may continue. Direct Customers – For the first quarter of fiscal year 2027, three direct customers represented 21%, 17%, and 16% of total revenue, all of which was primarily attributable to the Compute & Networking segment. For the first quarter of fiscal year 2026, sales to two direct customers represented 16% and 14% of total revenue, which were attributable to the Compute & Networking segment. Indirect Customers – Indirect customer revenue is an estimation based upon multiple factors including customer purchase order information, product specifications, internal sales data, and other sources. Indirect customers primarily purchase our products through system integrators and distributors. We generate a significant amount of our revenue from a limited number of indirect customers, some individually representing 10% or more of our revenue. Certain companies purchase cloud and related services through various direct and indirect customers. We estimate that one AI research and deployment company contributed to a meaningful amount of our revenue by purchasing cloud services from our customers in the first quarter of fiscal year 2027. Revenue by geographic region is designated based on the location of the headquarters of direct customers. Gross Profit and Gross Margin

Gross profit consists of total net revenue less cost of revenue. These restrictions impacted exports of certain chips, as well as software, hardware, equipment and technology used to develop, produce and manufacture certain chips to China (including Hong Kong and Macau) and Russia, and specifically impact our A100 and H100 integrated circuits, DGX or any other systems or boards which incorporate A100 or H100 integrated circuits. During the second quarter of fiscal year 2024, the USG also informed us of an additional licensing requirement for a subset of A100 and H100 products destined to certain customers and other regions, including some countries in the Middle East. During the third quarter of fiscal year 2024, the USG announced new and updated licensing requirements for exports to China and Country Groups D:1, D:4, and D:5 (including but not limited to, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, and Vietnam, but excluding Israel) of our products exceeding certain performance thresholds, including, but not limited to, the A100, A800, H100, H800, L4, L40, L40S RTX 4090, GB200 NVL72, and B200. The licensing requirements also apply to the export of products exceeding certain performance thresholds to a party headquartered in, or with an ultimate parent headquartered in, Country Group D5, including China. On April 9, 2025, the USG informed us that it requires a license for export to China (including Hong Kong and Macau) and D:5 countries, or to companies headquartered or with an ultimate parent therein, of our H20 integrated circuits and any other circuits achieving the H20’s memory bandwidth, interconnect bandwidth, or combination thereof. As a result of these new requirements, we incurred a $4.5 billion charge in the first quarter of fiscal year 2026 associated with H20 for excess inventory and purchase obligations, as the demand for H20 products diminished. The export controls applicable to China are complex and address a variety of parameters, including the total processing performance of a chip, the “performance density” of a chip, the interconnect bandwidth of a chip, and the memory bandwidth of a chip. Under the current rules and geopolitical landscape, we are unable to create and deliver a competitive product for China’s data center market that receives approval from both the USG and the Chinese government. We have effectively been foreclosed from competing in China's data center computing/compute market, and our effective foreclosure from the China market will help our competitors build larger developer and customer ecosystems to challenge us worldwide. Unless we are able to return with a product that meets the approval of both the USG and the Chinese government, our lost opportunity and the benefit to our competitors will have a material and adverse impact on our business, operating results, and financial condition.

records.query: 為什麼大家做 AI 都要靠 NVIDIA 的技術，別家學不來？
records.answer:
大家在建置 AI 時幾乎都依賴 NVIDIA 的技術，因為 NVIDIA 提供了從硬體到軟體、從晶片到完整平台的全方位解決方案，且在效能、開發者生態與研發投入上具備難以被競爭者快速複製的領先優勢。  

- NVIDIA 的核心是 **GPU**，具備「數萬個運算核心」與 **Tensor Core**，專為深度學習訓練與推論設計，提供 AI 工作負載所需的高平行度與效能，這是其他廠商難以在同一時間同時提供相同規模與效能的硬體基礎【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。  
- NVIDIA 以 **CUDA** 為基礎的軟體堆疊涵蓋了開發平台、數百項領域專屬的函式庫、框架、演算法、SDK 與 API，形成「完整且統一的可程式化架構」來支援多種 AI、資料分析與科學運算應用，讓開發者能在同一套工具鏈上完成從模型訓練到部署的全部流程【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。  
- 公司的 **全端平台** 包含 GPU、CPU（Grace）、DPU、互連交換晶片、系統與軟體，並提供 **NVIDIA AI Enterprise**、**NVIDIA NIM**、**NeMo**、**AI Blueprints** 等企業級 AI 軟體套件，讓客戶在任何環境下都能快速建置與運行生成式 AI 應用【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28】。  
- NVIDIA 已累積 **超過 0.075 億（7.5 百萬）開發者** 使用 CUDA 及其他軟體工具，形成龐大的生態系統，開發者與合作夥伴的廣泛採用進一步提升平台價值與網路效應【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28】。  
- 在研發投入方面，NVIDIA 自成立以來已 **投資超過 767 億美元（$76.7 billion）** 於研發，持續推出領先世代的架構（如 **Blackwell**、**Rubin**），其中 Rubin 平台預計在 FY2027 下半年開始量產，並可提供「相較於 Blackwell 每個 token 成本降低最高 10 倍」的效能與成本優勢【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #25】。  
- NVIDIA 與 **OEM、ODM、系統整合商** 以及醫療、製造、汽車等多元產業的合作夥伴關係，使其產品能快速佈署於各類終端與資料中心，形成「硬體、軟體、服務」的完整供應鏈，進一步鞏固其在 AI 基礎設施市場的領導地位【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #25】。  
- 雖然市場上存在 AMD、Intel、華為、亞馬遜、Alphabet、Microsoft 等競爭者，但這些競爭者在 **「效能、產品廣度、客戶與合作夥伴渠道、軟體支援、符合產業標準 API、製造能力、價格與系統總成本」** 等關鍵競爭因素上仍難以同時匹配 NVIDIA 的全方位優勢【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #31】。  

綜合以上硬體效能、完整軟體堆疊、龐大開發者生態、持續高額研發投入與廣泛產業合作，形成了 NVIDIA 在 AI 領域的「平台護城河」，使得其他公司難以在短期內複製或取代其技術領導地位。

records.query: 微軟是怎麼把 AI 塞進 Office 那些軟體裡的？
records.answer:
微軟透過在 **Microsoft 365 Commercial** 平台內加入 **Microsoft 365 Copilot** 以及各項 AI‑enabled 功能，將人工智慧直接嵌入 Office 相關服務與雲端產品中【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52】。

- **Microsoft 365 Commercial** 被定位為「AI‑powered」的商務與生產力解決方案平台，將 Office、Windows、Microsoft 365 Copilot 與 Enterprise Mobility + Security 結合，讓 AI 工具與功能遍佈於協同、溝通、分析、資安與合規等多個領域【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52】。  
- AI 功能的加入包括「AI‑enabled tools、features、agentic scenarios」等，這些工具被整合進核心產品與服務，以提升使用者在文件、簡報、資料分析等工作流程中的智慧化體驗【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52】。  
- 微軟的雲端業務亦提供「AI‑driven products」來處理安全、合規、身分驗證與隱私等需求，這些 AI 服務在多雲、應用與裝置資產上提供端到端的保護，進一步支援 Office 及相關生產力套件的 AI 能力【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #49】。  
- 公司明確指出，AI 正被「建構進許多我們的產品與服務，包括我們的生產力服務」之中，且也讓客戶能在自行開發的解決方案中使用 AI，這表示 AI 已經深度整合於 Office 系列的雲端與本地應用【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #98】。  

總結來說，微軟以 **Microsoft 365 Copilot** 為核心，結合 AI‑enabled 工具與 AI‑driven 安全與合規服務，將人工智慧嵌入 Office 產品與相關雲端平台，形成一套跨產品、跨平台的智慧化生產力生態系統。

Our Productivity and Business Processes segment consists of products and services in our portfolio of productivity, communication, and information services, spanning a variety of devices and platforms. This segment primarily comprises:

The Ambitions That Drive Us

records.query: 亞馬遜最近在 AI 這塊砸錢做了什麼？跟哪家 AI 公司搭上線？
records.answer:
亞馬遜正加大對人工智慧與機器學習的投入，並已與 OpenAI Group PBC 簽署股權承諾書以展開合作【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #198】【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #123】。

- 亞馬遜在 2025 財年預計「技術與基礎建設」支出將持續上升，因為公司正增添基礎設施與員工，以支援其人工智慧與機器學習計畫，這會在短期內降低自由現金流【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #198】。  
- 這些投資涵蓋 AWS 的 AI 服務（包括計算、儲存、資料庫、分析與機器學習），以及開發創新軟硬體、衛星寬頻與自動駕駛車隊等相關項目【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #198】。  
- 為了取得 AI 技術與資源，亞馬遜於 2026 年 2 月 27 日與 OpenAI Group PBC 簽署了《股權承諾書協議》（Equity Commitment Letter Agreement），亞馬遜亦擔任唯一保證人，顯示雙方在 AI 領域已正式結盟【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #123】。  

因此，亞馬遜的 AI 相關支出正因擴充 AWS 服務與新興技術而上升，同時透過與 OpenAI 的股權合作，深化在生成式 AI 與機器學習領域的布局。

- **沉浸式元宇宙與 VR 硬體**：Meta 透過 Meta Quest 系列與 Meta Horizon Store 提供社交、遊戲、健身與娛樂等 VR 體驗，並加入「passthrough」功能讓使用者在虛擬與現實之間無縫切換，顯示公司希望以 VR 為入口推動元宇宙（metaverse）成為下一代社交平台【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131】。  
- **AI 眼鏡與 AR 發展**：Meta 已推出 Ray‑Ban Meta、Oakley Meta 兩款 AI 眼鏡，內建 Meta AI 對話助理，並於 2024 年展示 Orion 原型機（真實 AR 眼鏡），2025 年推出結合顯示屏的 Meta Ray‑Ban Display 以及可透過肌電訊號控制的 Meta Neural Band，說明其長期目標是將 AI 與 AR 結合，提供「個人超智慧」的穿戴式介面【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131】。  
- **AI 研發與超智慧願景**：Meta 投資前沿 AI 模型與生成式 AI，旨在打造「personal superintelligence」—— 超越人類智慧的 AI，並將其應用於內容排序、廣告工具、產品開發與新功能的創造，顯示公司把 AI 視為驅動元宇宙與未來平台的核心技術【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。  
- **計算需求與基礎設施**：由於 AI 與 VR 產品的計算需求持續擴大，Meta 正自建資料中心並使用第三方基礎設施，以確保足夠的算力支撐未來的 AI 與元宇宙服務【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #135】。  
- **風險與挑戰**：Meta 承認其在消費硬體與 VR/AR 技術上的經驗相對有限，市場接受度與跨平台互通性仍具不確定性，若 Reality Labs（負責 VR/AR 與 AI 眼鏡的部門）未能成功，可能影響整體營運與財務表現【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #72】。  

綜合以上，Meta 的發展方向是把 VR 眼鏡與 AI 眼鏡結合，透過持續的硬體創新與前沿 AI 研發，打造以沉浸式、互動式體驗為核心的元宇宙生態系，同時追求「個人超智慧」助理的落地與普及。

[META 10-K period 2025] Item 1.Business 

Overview

Our mission is to build the future of human connection and the technology that makes it possible. Our products enable people to connect and share through mobile devices, personal computers, virtual reality (VR) headsets, and AI glasses. We are innovating in artificial intelligence (AI) technologies to build transformative experiences and capabilities across our Family of Apps and new platforms, and to advance our vision to deliver personal superintelligence for everyone. We build technology that helps people connect and share, find and build communities, and grow businesses. We also help people discover and learn about what is going on in the world around them, enable people to share their experiences, ideas, photos, videos, and other content with audiences ranging from their closest family members and friends to the public at large, and stay connected everywhere by accessing our products. Meta is moving our offerings beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next computing platform. Our vision does not center on any single product, but rather an entire ecosystem of experiences, devices, and new technologies powered by AI. While the metaverse is in the very early stages of its development, we believe it will become the next computing platform and the future of social interaction. Across our work, we are innovating to build new experiences that help make our platform more social, useful, and immersive. Our AI investments support initiatives across our products and services, helping power the systems that rank content in our apps, our discovery engine that recommends relevant content, the tools advertisers use to reach customers, the development of new generative AI experiences, and the tools that make our product development more efficient and productive. We are also working to develop the next generation of AI models and advance our vision to build superintelligence, which we define as AI that surpasses human intelligence. Although it is inherently difficult to predict when superintelligence may be achieved, we are investing now because we believe this has the potential to begin a new era of individual empowerment, where people can direct superintelligence towards what they value in their own lives. Family of Apps Products

•Facebook. Facebook helps give people the power to build community and bring the world closer together. It's a place for people to share life's moments and discuss what's happening, nurture and build relationships, discover and connect to people with shared interests, and create economic opportunity. They can do this through Feed, Reels, Stories, Groups, Marketplace, and more. •Instagram. Instagram brings people closer to the people and things they love. Instagram Feed, Stories, Reels, Live, and messaging are places where people and creators can connect and express themselves through photos, video, and private messaging, and discover and shop from their favorite businesses. •Messenger. Messenger is a simple yet powerful messaging application for people to connect with friends, family, communities, and businesses across platforms and devices through text, audio, and video calls. •Meta AI. Meta AI is an assistant that's available across our apps, as a stand-alone app, on our AI glasses, and on the web. It's designed to help people learn, get things done, create content, and connect with others to make the most of every moment.

[META 10-K period 2025] Our product development philosophy centers on continuous innovation in creating and improving products that are social by design, which means that our products are designed to place people and their social interactions at the core of the product experience. Historically, the increases in our computing needs have been driven by growth in our user base as well as engagement with products like video and VR. Our increased efforts toward building frontier AI models have driven a significant further expansion in our computing needs and we expect our computing needs to continue to expand as a result. We have designed and built our own data centers and key portions of our technical infrastructure, and a substantial portion of our technical infrastructure is also provided by third parties. Our ability to provide and continue to innovate our products and services depends on the continued availability of components, power, and network capacity. We make significant investments in technology both to improve our existing products and services and to develop new ones, as well as for our marketers and developers. We are also investing in protecting the security, privacy, and integrity of our platform by investing in both people and technology to strengthen our systems against abuse. Across all of these efforts, we are making significant investments in AI initiatives, including generative AI and superintelligence, to, among other things, recommend relevant content across our products through our AI-powered discovery engine, enhance our advertising tools and improve our ad delivery, targeting, and measurement capabilities, and to develop new products as well as new features for existing products. We have a history of open-sourcing in AI, including releasing our Llama foundation models as well as other models and tools, and continue to believe in the power of open source innovation. By sharing these resources, we aim to accelerate AI research, improve our products, and foster innovation across the tech community. We have not released everything we have developed historically and expect to continue training a combination of open and closed models going forward. Sales and Operations 

The majority of our marketers use our self-service ad platform to launch and manage their advertising campaigns. We also have a global sales force that is focused on attracting and retaining advertisers and providing support to them throughout the stages of the marketing cycle from pre-purchase decision-making to real-time optimizations to post-campaign analytics. We work directly with these advertisers, as well as through advertising agencies and resellers. We operate offices in more than 90 cities around the globe, the majority of which have a sales presence. We also invest in and rely on self-service tools to provide direct customer support to our users and partners. For our RL products, our sales efforts utilize third-party sales channels such as retailers, resellers, and distribution partners, and our direct-to-consumer channel, Meta.com, and several Meta stores. These efforts are focused on driving consumer and enterprise sales and adoption of our Meta Quest portfolio of products and AI glasses. 8


Marketing

Historically, our communities have generally grown organically with people inviting their friends to connect with them, supported by internal efforts to stimulate awareness and interest. In addition, we have invested and will continue to invest in marketing our products and services to grow our brand and help build community around the world. Intellectual Property

[META 10-K period 2025] In the near term, we are continuing to develop products and experiences that help people feel connected, anytime, anywhere. Our current product offerings in VR include our Meta Quest devices, as well as software and content available through the Meta Horizon Store, which enable a range of social experiences that allow people to defy physical distance while engaging in gaming, fitness, entertainment, and more. To drive greater adoption and acceptance of VR we have introduced passthrough capabilities, which allow users to experience the immersion and presence of VR while still being grounded in the physical world, through our Meta Quest devices. Our wearables efforts include our AI glasses and long-term AR initiatives. Our current AI glasses include the Ray-Ban Meta and Oakley Meta glasses, which feature Meta AI, our advanced conversational assistant, as well as other features such as hands-free interaction. As we continue our long-term efforts to bring AR glasses to market, in 2024 we also unveiled our Orion prototype, a pair of true AR glasses that overlay content on top of the physical world. It does this with an industry-leading field of view and in glasses form factor for comfortable wear. In 2025, we introduced Meta Ray-Ban Display, which combines our AI glasses with an integrated display built into the lens. It comes with the Meta Neural Band, which is a wrist-worn wearable device that uses electromyography to let people control their AI glasses using neuromuscular signals. In general, our Reality Labs efforts include shorter-term projects developing specific products and services to go to market, as well as longer-term research and development projects.

[META 10-Q period 202603] We may not be successful in our Reality Labs strategy and investments, which could adversely affect our business, reputation, or financial results. We believe the metaverse, an embodied internet where people have immersive experiences beyond two-dimensional screens, is the next evolution in social technology. In 2021, we announced a shift in our business and product strategy to focus on helping to bring the metaverse to life, and we are directing our efforts toward innovations in AI, wearables, and devices to help build next-generation interfaces. We expect this will be a complex, evolving, and long-term initiative that will involve the development of new and emerging technologies, continued investment in infrastructure as well as privacy, safety, and security efforts, and collaboration with other companies, developers, partners, and other participants. However, the metaverse may not develop in accordance with our expectations, and market acceptance of features, products, or services we build is uncertain. We regularly evaluate our product roadmaps and make significant changes as our understanding of the technological challenges and market landscape and our product ideas and designs evolve. In addition, we have relatively limited experience with consumer hardware products and virtual and augmented reality technology, which may enable other companies to compete more effectively than us. We may be unsuccessful in our research and product development efforts, including if we are unable to develop relationships with key participants in the metaverse or develop products that operate effectively with metaverse technologies, products, systems, networks, or standards. For example, some of our consumer hardware products depend on the ability to operate with third-party mobile platforms and these platforms do not necessarily provide our products with the same levels of interoperability that they provide to their own competing products. In addition, our Reality Labs efforts may also divert resources and management attention from other areas of our business. We expect to continue to make significant investments in virtual and augmented reality and other technologies to support these efforts, and our ability to support these efforts is dependent on generating sufficient profits from other areas of our business. In addition, as our Reality Labs efforts evolve, we may be subject to a variety of existing or new laws and regulations in the United States and international jurisdictions, including in the areas of privacy, safety, AI, competition, content regulation, medical devices, tariffs, export controls, consumer protection, and e-commerce, which may delay or impede the development of our products 

65


and services, increase our operating costs, require significant management time and attention, or otherwise harm our business. As a result of these or other factors, our Reality Labs strategy and investments may not be successful in the foreseeable future, or at all, which could adversely affect our business, reputation, or financial results. If we are not able to maintain and enhance our brands, our ability to maintain or expand our base of users, marketers, and developers may be impaired, and our business and financial results may be harmed.

records.query: 特斯拉的自動駕駛跟別家車廠比，厲害在哪裡？
records.answer:
特斯拉的自動駕駛之所以被認為較其他車廠更具優勢，主要在於它擁有全套自研的 AI 軟硬體、以視覺為核心的神經網路、客製化的推論晶片，以及透過 OTA 持續更新的軟體平台，且已於 2025 年 6 月推出以 Model Y 為基礎的 Robotaxi 服務，這些都讓 Tesla 能在軟體驅動的服務模型上領先於仍以傳統手寫程式或外部供應鏈為主的競爭者【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31】。

- **全車設計即具備自動駕駛能力**：Tesla 表示「每一台今天交付的 Tesla 車輛皆為自動駕駛而設計」，意味著硬體與軟體從一開始即為 AI 自主駕駛做最適化，而非後裝【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31】。  
- **視覺為主的神經網路與自家推論晶片**：公司使用「視覺‑基礎技術、系統與軟體」來訓練人工神經網路，並由「自家設計的客製化推論晶片」加速運算，這與許多傳統車廠仍依賴手寫程式或外部硬體的做法形成對比【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31】。  
- **OTA（Over‑the‑Air）軟體更新**：Tesla 透過 OTA 讓所有車輛的自動駕駛功能持續改進，確保新功能與安全性可即時下放，這在業界屬於較少見的完整軟體迭代能力【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31】。  
- **已營運的 Robotaxi 服務**：2025 年 6 月正式上線的 Robotaxi 平台，已在實際商業環境中驗證自動駕駛技術，並計畫未來以 Cybercab 等專屬自動車型擴大規模，顯示 Tesla 不僅在技術層面，亦在服務模式上領先【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31】。  
- **AI 能力的差異化聲明**：Tesla 明確指出「我們的 AI 能力與進步使我們與競爭對手區隔開來」；相較之下，其他汽車製造商「擁有更大或更成熟的資源」但在 AI 與軟體整合上仍落後【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66】。  

綜合以上，Tesla 以完整的自研 AI 生態系、視覺‑導向的神經網路、專屬推論晶片、持續 OTA 更新以及已投入營運的 Robotaxi 服務，形成了相較於傳統車廠在自動駕駛領域的明顯競爭優勢。
